source_snapshot.procedure: Create a user in BMC Web, Redfish GET requires PasswordChangeRequired=true, PATCH the password, then GET requires false.
source_snapshot.criteria: The value can be set successfully.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; substitutes Redfish POST/GET for WebUI creation and omits the required true→false flag transition; warns to remove a throwaway account.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores WebUI creation, exact GET/PATCH/GET transition, least privilege, secret safety, recovery and cleanup.

old_problem: DeepSeek dropped the WebUI-to-Redfish interoperability and explicit PasswordChangeRequired transition. The source embeds unsafe credentials/literal password and assumes username equals Member URI, creating wrong-account and lockout risk.
disposition_reason: DMTF Redfish defines ManagerAccount PasswordChangeRequired and the supported password-change behavior, including clearing the flag after an allowed Password update. ED-04/15/20 allow temporary identity, role, secret policy, URI mapping and cleanup as project inputs. The exact source sequence is retained with protected secrets and an independent recovery admin.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2239, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2240 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00022-V001 / ad3ee54c3a3f5856 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
DMTF Redfish specifies PasswordChangeRequired on ManagerAccount and, subject to AccountService policy, an allowed Password update that clears the property.
Prove the unique temporary least-privilege username is unused and preserve a separate verified recovery administrator.
Create exactly once through the source-required BMC Web UI; Redfish POST is not a substitute.
Discover the exact ManagerAccount Member URI by stable ID/username mapping, then GET the full redacted resource and require PasswordChangeRequired=true.
PATCH only Password using protected generated input—never the literal example or credentials in URL/history—and use ETag/If-Match if required by the service.
GET again and require false while username/role/enabled/locked and unrelated properties remain stable; then delete/disable and verify audit cleanup.
Stop on collision, wrong URI/role, lockout, flag anomaly or cleanup failure; no credential retry. No account/password action or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: WebUI-created BMC account PasswordChangeRequired true-to-false Redfish lifecycle
test_case.purpose: Verify WebUI-to-Redfish account interoperability: a temporary account initially requires a password change, one authorized password update clears the flag on the same principal, and cleanup leaves no residual access.
required_package: BMC/firmware/AccountService schema and WebUI user behavior
Compliant protected initial/new secrets and password policy
Stable WebUI-user-to-ManagerAccount URI mapping, TLS trust, ETag policy, recovery admin and cleanup/final state
test_case.test_command: With independent recovery proven, create the approved temporary account once through BMC Web; discover and verify its exact ManagerAccount URI; secret-safely GET and require PasswordChangeRequired=true; PATCH only Password once using protected input and required ETag; GET again and require false with stable identity/role/state; then delete or disable per policy and verify audit/cleanup.
test_case.expected_result: The WebUI-created principal maps to one exact ManagerAccount, initially reports PasswordChangeRequired=true, changes to false after the authorized password update while unrelated account properties remain unchanged, and is completely deleted/disabled as approved without affecting other access.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires WebUI creation, exact resource correlation, redacted true→false GET/PATCH/GET evidence, minimal property diff and verified cleanup. Redfish POST substitution, hardcoded secret, list-only evidence, wrong URI or residual privilege is not PASS. Missing bindings blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until unused username, least role, protected secrets, exact URI mapping, TLS/ETag policy, recovery admin and cleanup are signed.
Never place secrets in URLs, logs, process output, screenshots or artifacts.
PATCH only the verified temporary account's Password once; no other account/policy change or credential retry.
Stop on collision, wrong identity/role, lockout, unexpected diff or cleanup failure.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, BMC/firmware/AccountService and recovery-admin readiness
Approved temporary identity/role and WebUI creation status without secrets
Exact Member URI/ID and redacted first GET with PasswordChangeRequired=true
Secret-safe PATCH HTTP/task/ETag metadata and redacted second GET with false plus minimal diff
Security/audit entries, deletion/disable cleanup and no-secret/no-unrelated-change audit
test_case.recovery: On wrong account, lockout or flag anomaly, do not retry credentials. Preserve redacted evidence and use the independent administrator to disable/delete the temporary account and verify all intended management access remains healthy.
